z-m-03-01.title: Pepa refu rakatetepa nepepa rakakora: ripi rakakura muarea?
z-m-03-01.topic: Kuenzanisa area (kuisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe, nekuenzanisa nema squares ehukuru hwakafanana)
z-m-03-01.goal: Enzanisa nzvimbo yamapepa maviri anoratidzika akasiyana muchimiro nokuona nameso, nokuiisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe, nokuenzanisa nemasikweya akaenzana, uchigadzirisa kutonga kwako sezvaunoenderera, uye utaure kuti imwe nzira inodikanwa kana kuisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe kusingasarudzi.
z-m-03-01.material: Pane mapepa maviri akaita serekitengi akagadzirwa nepepa rakakora, '가' ne '나'. '가' irekitengi rakareba kubva kudivi kuenda kudivi, uye '나' irekitengi risina kureba uye rakakora kupfuura '가'. Unoda kuziva kuti ndeipi iri huru munzvimbo (hukuru hwenzvimbo inotorwa nepepa). Hausati wayera kureba.
z-m-03-01.thinking.1: Kuchinja kuvimba kwako sezvo ruzivo rutsva rwuchiuya
z-m-03-01.prereq.0: Kuziva 'yakapamhama/yakatetepa' nokuenzanisa zvinhu zviviri nokuisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe (nhanho yeGiredhi 1)
z-m-03-01.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa rumwe panguva imwe. Nguva yega yega, sarudza zvaunofunga pamusoro pokuti ndeipi iri huru munzvimbo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.0: Pachikamu chega chega, taura chinhu chimwe pamusoro pe 'zvakafanana nezvakasiyana' muzvawadzidza nyowani.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kucheka mapepa maviri uye kuisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe, uye utevedze nechigunwe zvikamu zvinobuda.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Mapepa maviri akaiswa pakaparadzana patafura uye unotarisa chete nameso. '가' inoratidzika yakareba uye '나' inoratidzika yakakora.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga kuti ndeipi iri huru munzvimbo parizvino?
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Zvakaoma kusarudza nokungotarisa nameso. Unoda nzira se kuisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe kana kuenzanisa nezvidimbu zvakaenzana.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 가 ndiyo huru. Upamhi hurefu, saka refu ndiro guru.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakatarisa kureba munzira imwe chete. Kunzvimbo unofanira kufunga nezveupamhi nokukwirira pamwe chete.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hauzive nokungotarisa. Unofanira kuiisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe kana kuyera.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakatanga wafunga nzira yokutarisa. Ihoko yakanaka kuparadzanisa manzwiro nokutarisa.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 나 ndiyo huru. Yakakora, saka inoratidzika yakazara.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakasarudza nomanzwiro. Zvingava zvakarurama, asi haugoni kuziva usati watarisa.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zvimiro zvakasiyana, saka nzvimbo dzakasiyana zvirokwazvo. Hatizivi chete kuti ndeipi iri huru.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kunyange zvimiro zvakasiyana, nzvimbo dzinogona kuva dzakafanana. Hapana chikonzero chokutaura nenzira yakasimba kudaro.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Waisa '가' pamusoro pe '나' nemakona epamusoro kuruboshwe akaenzanisa. '가' inobuda kupfuura '나' kurudyi, uye '나' inobuda kupfuura '가' kuenda pasi. Hapana chimwe chinofukidza chimwe zvizere.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana rimwe richifukidza rimwe zvizere, unogona kutaura kuti rakafukidzwa idiki munzvimbo. Asi kana rimwe nerimwe richibuda, zvakaoma kusarudza nokuiisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe oga.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 가 ndiyo huru. Chikamu chinobuda chinoenderera chakareba kurudyi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatarisa chete kureba kwechikamu chinobuda. Funga nezve 나 inobuda sei pasi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 나 ndiyo huru. Chikamu chinobuda pasi chinoratidzika chakakora.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Zvingaratidzika kudaro, asi hausati waenzanisa hukuru hwezvikamu zviviri zvinobuda.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Nzvimbo mbiri dzakafanana. Zvikamu zvinobuda zvinoratidzika zvakafanana.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kuratidzika kwakafanana hakusi chikonzero chokutaura kuti zvakafanana. Zvingava zvakafanana, asi unofanira kutarisa zvakawanda.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Haugoni kusarudza nokuiisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe oga. Unoda imwe nzira zvakare.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakacherechedza kuti kana rimwe nerimwe richibuda mushure mokuiisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe, haugoni kuziva pakarepo kuti ndeipi iri huru.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Pamapepa ose mbiri, makeshi madiki esikweya akaenzana muhukuru akadhirowa pasina mukaha. '가' ine mitsetse 2 yemakeshi 6 kubva kudivi kuenda kudivi, uye '나' ine mitsetse 3 yemakeshi 4 kubva kudivi kuenda kudivi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kana ukaenzanisa nemakeshi, ndeipi iri huru munzvimbo?
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 가 mitsetse 2 yemakeshi 6, 나 mitsetse 3 yemakeshi 4, uye makeshi akaenzana muhukuru, saka zvose zvine makeshi 12. Saka kunyange zvimiro zvakasiyana, nzvimbo dzakafanana. Kana makeshi ari hukuru hwakasiyana, haugoni kuenzanisa nenzira iyi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Mapepa ose mbiri ane makeshi 12, akafanana, saka nzvimbo dzakafanana.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakaenzanisa nokuti pane makeshi mangani zvose kana makeshi akaenzana muhukuru. Wakafunga nezvechimiro nenzvimbo zvakasiyana.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 가 ndiyo huru. Pane makeshi 6 mumutsetse, akawanda kupfuura 4.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatarisa mutsetse mumwe chete. Unofanirawo kufunga kuti pane mitsetse mingani.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 나 ndiyo huru. Pane mitsetse 3, mizhinji kupfuura 2.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakatarisa chete huwandu hwemitsetse. Unofanirawo kufunga kuti pane makeshi mangani mumutsetse.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kana zvimiro zvakasiyana, haugoni kuenzanisa nzvimbo nokuverenga makeshi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kana makeshi akaenzana muhukuru, unogona kuenzanisa nokuti pane makeshi mangani zvose, kunyange zvimiro zvakasiyana.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.reflect: Kufunga kwako kwakachinja sei kubva pakutanga paakatarisa nameso, kusvika paakaiisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe, kusvika paakaenzanisa nemakeshi? Kuti uenzanise nemakeshi, chii chinofanira kufanana pamakeshi?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari yakati, "Zvimiro zvakasiyana, saka nzvimbo dzakasiyanawo!" Ungada kuudza shamwari yako chii?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga kana pane muenzaniso mumapepa awakangoona unoita kuti chirevo cheshamwari yako chiratidzike chakanganisa.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wanyora kuti nhamba dzipi dzaunogona kushandisa sehumbowo mumuenzaniso uwoyo, wobva wagadzira mutsara.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Zvimedu zvehumbowo zvandakanyora (huwandu hwemakeshi, nezvimwewo) inhamba dzemapepa maviri chaizvo here?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here 'zvimiro zvakasiyana' ne 'nzvimbo dzakasiyana' zvakasiyana?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataurawo here mamiriro okuti makeshi akaenzana muhukuru?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.model.0: Mapepa ose mbiri ane makeshi 12, saka nzvimbo dzakafanana. Kunyange zvimiro zvakasiyana, nzvimbo dzinogona kuva dzakafanana.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.model.1: Handina kukwanisa kuziva nokuiisa rimwe pamusoro perimwe, asi kana ndakaverenga nemakeshi akaenzana muhukuru, zvose 가 ne 나 ndi makeshi 12. Saka nzvimbo dzakafanana.

z-m-03-06.title: Kutarisa pasi kubva pamusoro ndinoona 3, saka kune mangani akavanzwa pasi?
z-m-03-06.goal: Ronga zvaunogona kutaura nechokwadi nezvausingagone kubva pamaonero ari pamusoro oga, uye ugadzire nzira dzakati wandei dzekuturikidza dzinoratidzika dzakafanana kubva pamusoro uye dzine huwandu hwese hwematombo hwakafanana.
z-m-03-06.material: Matawa matatu akavakwa padivi pedivi nematombo ehukuru hwakafanana. Pane rimwe kuruboshwe, rimwe pakati, uye rimwe kurudyi. Tawa rega rega rakaturikidzwa kubva pasi, uye tawa rega rega rine mazinga 1 kusvika 3. Kutarisa pasi kubva pamusoro, unoona tombo repamusoro chete retawa rega rega. Haugone kuona kubva pamusoro kuti pane mazinga angani ematombo pasi.
z-m-03-06.thinking.0: Kupatsanura zvaunoziva nechokwadi nezvausingazivi kubva pazvauri kuona
z-m-03-06.s.s1.prompt: Unoziva maonero ekutarisa pasi kubva pamusoro chete. Sarudza zvese zvaunogona kutaura nechokwadi kubva pane izvi oga.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa matombo aunoona nematombo akavanzwa pasi.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.hint.1: Edza rimwe nerimwe kana chirevo chimwe nechimwe chiri chechokwadi nguva dzose kunyange kana matawa ane huwandu hwemazinga hwakasiyana.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga matombo epamusoro aunoona chete. Funga kana pangava nematombo akawanda pamazinga epasi.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.b: Ichi i chokwadi chaunogona kuziva nechokwadi kubva pamaonero ari pamusoro. Tarisa zvakare kuti hauna kusiya chinhu.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.d: Ichi i chokwadi chaunogona kuziva nechokwadi kubva pamaonero ari pamusoro. Tarisa zvakare kuti hauna kusiya chinhu.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakasarudza kare kuti tawa rega rega rine mazinga 2. Ndiani akataura izvozvo?
z-m-03-06.s.s1.r.e: Mazinga 3 i refu zvinogoneka chete, uye kubva pamusoro haugone kuona kuti tawa ripi rine mazinga 3.
z-m-03-06.s.s1.explain: Kubva pamusoro unoona matombo 3 epamusoro chete, saka zvauri kuziva nechokwadi chete i kuti pane matawa 3 uye matombo 3 zvishoma. Mazinga epasi anogona kusiyana kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 3, saka huwandu hwese i pakati pe 3 ne 9, uye haugone kutaura nhamba chaiyo.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira nzira 3 dzakasiyana dzekusarudza huwandu hwemazinga ematawa matatu kuti huwandu hwese ive matombo 7. Maonero ekubva pamusoro anofanira kuramba akafanana.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawana chiitiko chimwe apo huwandu hwemazinga ematawa matatu hunowedzera kusvika ku 7.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tawa rega rega rine mazinga 1 kusvika 3. Gadzira imwe nzira nekubvisa zinga rimwe patawa rimwe nekuwedzera zinga rimwe patawa rimwe.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.fail.c0: Huwandu hwemazinga hunofanira kuva nhamba yekuverenga sa 1, 2, 3.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Matawa ese matatu ane mazinga 1 kusvika 3.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Matawa ane mazinga 1 kusvika 3. Ne mazinga 0 haagone kuonekwa kubva pamusoro, uye haugone kugadzira mazinga 4 kana kupfuura.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Huwandu hwemazinga ematawa matatu hunofanira kuwedzera kusvika ku matombo 7.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.explain: Zviitiko apo huwandu hwemazinga hunowedzera kusvika ku 7 i (1, 3, 3), (3, 1, 3), (3, 3, 1), (2, 2, 3), (2, 3, 2), (3, 2, 2), iyo i nzira 6. Mune imwe neimwe yadzo, unoona matombo 3 epamusoro chete kubva pamusoro, saka maonero anoratidzika akafanana chaizvo.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza imwe yenzira dzawakagadzira uye utsanangure kuti sei maonero ekubva pamusoro anoramba akafanana.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Taura kuti matombo api anogona kuonekwa uye api akavanzwa kana uchitarisa pasi kubva pamusoro.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tarisa kana kuchinja huwandu hwemazinga etawa kunochinja huwandu hwematombo aunoona kubva pamusoro.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Munzira yandakasarudza, nzvimbo dzese dzitatu dzemutsetse wekumashure dziri pamusoro kana pasi pemutsetse wekumberi here?
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakapa chikonzero che 'akavanzwa saka haugone kuaona' here?
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Kutarisa pasi kubva pamusoro, unoona matombo 3 epamusoro chete, uye matombo ari pasi akavanzwa nematombo ari pamusoro pawo. Saka kunyange kana huwandu hwemazinga hwakasiyana, maonero anoratidzika akafanana.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Ndakaturikidza mazinga 3, mazinga 3, nezinga 1. Kubva pamusoro unoona tombo rimwe repamusoro retawa rega rega, uye mazinga epasi akavanzwa uye haagone kuonekwa.
z-m-03-06.s.s2.because.model.2: Kubva pamusoro, matombo ari pasi akavanzwa mukati metawa uye haagone kuonekwa. Saka chimiro chaunoona chinoramba chakafanana.

z-m-03-02.title: Tambo yakarembera pakati pezvipikiri zviviri pamadziro: kureba kwayo kwakafananawo here?
z-m-03-02.goal: Tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mupfungwa yokuti tambo mbiri dzine kutanga nokupera kumwe chete dzinofanira kuva nokureba kwakafanana, uye utaure chii chimwe chinodikanwa kuti utaure kuti kureba kwakafanana uye nzira yokutarisa.
z-m-03-02.material: Pane zvipikiri zviviri pamadziro. Jia akarembedza tambo imwe isina kutambanuka zvakasimba pakati pezvipikiri zviviri. Minho akarembedza imwe tambo isina kutambanuka pazvipikiri zviviri zvimwe chete, asi akaiembedza kuti ikotamire pasi. Matambo ose mbiri anotanga pachipikiri chokuruboshwe uye anopera pachipikiri chokurudyi. Jia akafunga nenzira iyi.
z-m-03-02.prereq.0: Kuziva 'refu/pfupi' nokuenzanisa kureba kwezvinhu zviviri zvakananga nokuziisa mugumo kumugumo (nhanho yeGiredhi 1)
z-m-03-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe wokufunga kwaJia unotanga kukanganisa.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rongedza mutsetse wega wega kuva chokwadi chawakatarisa nameso nepfungwa yakatorwa kubva pazvokwadi.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.hint.1: Dhirowa uye uenzanise chimiro chetambo imwe yakatambanudzwa zvakasimba nechimiro chayo kana yakakotamira.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.0: Tambo yangu yakatambanuka zvakasimba, uye tambo yaMinho yakakotamira pasi.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.1: Zvakadaro, matambo ose mbiri akarembedzwa pachipikiri chokuruboshwe nechokurudyi.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.2: Kutanga nokupera zviri pazvinzvimbo zvimwe chete, saka matambo maviri akareba zvakafanana zvakare.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.line.3: Saka kunyange kana tikatambanudza tambo yaMinho zvakasimba, ichava nokureba kwakafanana netambo yangu.
z-m-03-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 unotanga kukanganisa. Kunyange kutanga nokupera zvakafanana, kureba kunogona kusiyana zvichienderana nokuti nzira yakananga kana yakakotama. Mutsetse 4 mhedziso inotevera kufunga komutsetse 3, saka kukanganisa kunouya shure. Mitsetse 1 ne 2 inotaura zvakaonekwa sezvazvakaita.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.prompt: Tambo yaMinho tambo isina kutambanukawo, sedzaJia. Parizvino tambo yaMinho chete ndiyo yakakotamira. Mamiriro api mamwe anodikanwa kuti tikwanise kutaura kuti matambo maviri akareba zvakafanana?
z-m-03-02.s.s2.hint.0: Taura kuti matambo maviri akarembedzwa nenzira dzakasiyana sei.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa imwe neimwe kana kureba kwetambo kungachinja kana mamiriro ega ega akachinja.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.r.a: Ruvara harina chokuita nokureba. Tsvaga zvinhu zvakabatana nokureba.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.o.b: Matambo ose mbiri anotanga pachipikiri chokuruboshwe uye anopera pachipikiri chokurudyi
z-m-03-02.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvatopiwa. Sezvawakaona pachikamu chapfuura, kuva nokutanga nokupera kumwe chete hakusarudzi kureba.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.o.c: Matambo ose mbiri akarembedzwa akananga uye akatambanuka zvakasimba
z-m-03-02.s.s2.o.d: Zvipikiri zviviri zviri pakukwirira kumwe chete pamadziro
z-m-03-02.s.s2.r.d: Kana zvipikiri zviri pakukwirira kumwe chete kana kwete, nzvimbo dzakarembedzwa matambo maviri dzakafanana. Nzira yakarembedzwa tambo inokosha zvikuru.
z-m-03-02.s.s2.explain: Kana matambo maviri akarembedzwa pazvipikiri zviviri zvimwe chete, kana ose akatambanuka zvakasimba, ose ndiyo nzira yakananga zvikuru, saka kureba kwakafanana. Kana kunyange rimwe rikakotamira, tambo iyoyo ingareba.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.prompt: Unoda kuziva kana tambo yaMinho yakareba sedzaJia. Nyora kuti ungatarisa sei uye mhedzisiro ipi yaunofunga kuti ichabuda.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira kusunungura matambo maviri kubva pazvipikiri uye kuaisa patafura.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira zvinoitika kune mimwe migumo kana ukarongedza mugumo mumwe wetambo mbiri idzi.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Nzira yandakatsanangura inoratidza chaizvo musiyano wokureba pakati pematambo maviri here?
z-m-03-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza here chikonzero chemhedzisiro yawakatarisira ne 'kukotamira/kutambanuka'?
z-m-03-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga here kuti matambo maviri angabuda akareba zvakafananawo?
z-m-03-02.s.s3.model.0: Tambanudza tambo yaMinho zvakasimba uye uiise padivi petambo yaJia. Ndinofunga tambo yakakotamira ichareba.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.model.1: Tambanudza matambo ose mbiri, isa mugumo mumwe wega wega pamwe chete, uye utarise kuti mugumo mumwe uri kupi, uye unogona kuona kuti kureba kungasiyana.
z-m-03-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhedzisiro yakatarisirwa pfupi, asi inotaura nzira nomukana.

z-m-03-03.title: Kana ukacheka pepa resikweya kamwe nokucheka kwakananga, zvikamu zvichaoneka sei?
z-m-03-03.topic: Kupatsanura zvimiro zvakatsetseka (makona akapinza ezvikamu zvakachekwa nomutsetse mumwe wakananga)
z-m-03-03.goal: Tsvaga zvimiro zvezvikamu zviviri zvaunogona kugadzira nokucheka kamwe kwakananga nokutarisa huwandu hwemakona akapinza, uye utsvage uye utsanangure nyaya dzakawanda dzinogoneka iwe pachako.
z-m-03-03.material: Pane pepa resikweya. Rine makona 4. Unocheka pepa kamwe chete nemakasi nomutsetse wakananga, uchariparadzanisa kuva zvikamu zviviri. Kucheka kunobatanidza mapoinzi maviri pamicheto miviri yakasiyana yepepa. Poinzi inogona kuva pakona, kana panzvimbo yepakati yomucheto.
z-m-03-03.prereq.0: Kuziva zvimiro zvekatatu nezvekwadhirateri nokunongedza nechigunwe 'kona yakapinza' (apo mitsetse miviri yakananga inosangana)
z-m-03-03.s.s1.prompt: Wakacheka pepa kamwe nokucheka kwakananga uye wakawana zvikamu zviviri. Kana ukawedzera makona ose akapinza ezvikamu zviviri, zvinoenzaniswa sei nemakona akapinza 4 epepa rekutanga?
z-m-03-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kotamisa pepa kuti riite diki uye richeke kamwe nemakasi, wobva waverenga makona ezvikamu zviviri imwe neimwe.
z-m-03-03.s.s1.hint.1: Wedzera nhamba dzawakaverenga uye uenzanise huwandu nemakona 4 epepa rekutanga.
z-m-03-03.s.s1.o.a: Zvakafanana ne 4. Pepa rakangoparadzanwa kuva zviviri.
z-m-03-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga chete makona akatovapo. Chii chinoitika kumigumo miviri yomutsetse wokucheka?
z-m-03-03.s.s1.r.b: Pepa kuva diki kwakasiyana nehuwandu hwemakona. Funga makona matsva anoumbwa pakacheka.
z-m-03-03.s.s1.o.c: Zvichienderana nokuti wakacheka papi, zvinogona kuva shoma kana kupfuura 4.
z-m-03-03.s.s1.r.c: Paradzanisa zvikamu zvinochinja zvichienderana nokuti wakacheka papi nezvikamu zvinogara zvakafanana.
z-m-03-03.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga kuti migumo yomutsetse wokucheka inogadzira sei makona matsva pazvikamu zvose zviviri.
z-m-03-03.s.s1.explain: Kana ukacheka pepa, makona akapinza anoonekwa pazvikamu zvose zviviri kumigumo miviri yomutsetse wokucheka. Kana akaverengwa pamwe chete, anogara ari anopfuura 4 (pakati pe 6 ne 8).
z-m-03-03.s.s2.prompt: Nyora huwandu hwemakona ezvikamu zviviri zvokucheka kamwe kwakananga nenhevedzano (shoma, akawanda), uye ugadzire mapeya 3 akasiyana. Kana zvikamu zviviri zvine huwandu hwakafanana, nyora nhamba iyoyo kaviri. Unogona kuyedza nokucheka mapepa.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.hint.0: Uchicheka pepa chaizvo, famba migumo miviri yomutsetse wokucheka kunzvimbo dzakasiyana pamicheto.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti makona akapinza ezvikamu anosiyana sei kana mugumo mumwe waiswa pakona yakapinza nekana waiswa panzvimbo yepakati yomucheto.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.hint.2: Pane kutsvaga imwe nzira yokuwana peya imwe chete, tsvaga peya yakasiyana.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.var.p: Huwandu hwemakona ezvikamu zvine makona mashoma (kana huwandu iyoyo kana zvakaenzana)
z-m-03-03.s.s2.var.q: Huwandu hwemakona ezvikamu zvine makona akawanda
z-m-03-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Huwandu hwemakona akapinza inhamba yokuverenga se 1, 2, 3.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.ok.c1: p ndi 3 kana kupfuura uye haipfuuri q.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Chikamu chimiro chakakomberedzwa nemitsetse yakananga, saka chine makona 3 kana kupfuura, uye unonyora huwandu diki kutanga.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Huwandu hwemakona akapinza ezvikamu zviviri ndi 8 kana shoma.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Nokucheka kamwe kwakananga, haugoni kuita kuti makona akapinza ezvikamu zviviri awedzere kupfuura 8.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.explain: Mapeya anogoneka ndi (3, 3), (3, 4), (3, 5), (4, 4). Kubatanidza makona akapinza maviri akatarisana kunopa (3, 3). Kubatanidza kona imwe yakapinza nepakati pomucheto wakatarisana kunopa (3, 4). Kubatanidza nzvimbo dzepakati dzemicheto miviri iri padhuze uye kucheka kona kunopa (3, 5). Kubatanidza nzvimbo dzepakati dzemicheto miviri yakatarisana kunopa (4, 4). Haugoni kuita peya ine makona akapinza 2 kana nehuwandu hwe 9 kana kupfuura.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza imwe yemapeya awakagadzira uye utsanangure nemashoko kuti wakacheka sei pepa.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tanga wataura kuti mugumo wega wega womutsetse wokucheka uri pakona yakapinza kana panzvimbo yepakati yomucheto.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Pa mazita kuzvimiro zvezvikamu zviviri (katatu, kwadhirateri, nezvimwewo).
z-m-03-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Nenzira yokucheka yandakatsanangura, (p, q) iyoyo inobuda chaizvo here?
z-m-03-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Zvakajeka here kuti wakaisa migumo miviri kupi?
z-m-03-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ukacheka nomutsetse unobatanidza makona akapinza 2 akatarisana, unowana zvikamu 2 zvekatatu, uye chimwe nechimwe chine makona akapinza 3.
z-m-03-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana ukabatanidza nzvimbo dzepakati dzemicheto miviri iri padhuze uye ukacheka kona imwe, chikamu chidiki chekatatu chine makona akapinza 3 uye chikuru chine 5.

z-m-03-04.title: Makuki ehuro nenyeredzi anofanira kuenda mubhokisi ripi?
z-m-03-04.topic: Kurongedza zvimiro zvakatsetseka (katatu, kwadhirateri, zvimiro zvedenderedzwa nezvimiro zvisiri chimwe chezvi)
z-m-03-04.goal: Kana ukasangana nechimiro chisingagoni kurongedzwa mumabhokisi matatu, sarudzazve chiyero chokurongedza, gadzira mutemo wako wokurongedza, uye utsanangure nezvikonzero.
z-m-03-04.material: Chitoro chemakuki chinoda kuisa makuki akatsetseka mumabhokisi nechimiro. Pane mabhokisi matatu: 'bhokisi rekatatu', 'bhokisi rekwadhirateri', ne 'bhokisi redenderedzwa'. Makuki ndiwo 2 ane chimiro chekatatu, 3 ane chimiro chesikweya, 4 ane chimiro chedenderedzwa, 2 ane chimiro chehuro, uye 1 ine chimiro chenyeredzi. Nyeredzi ine makona akapinza 5 uye micheto yayo yose mitsetse yakananga. Huro ine mutsetse wakakotama pamucheto wepamusoro nekona imwe yakapinza pasi.
z-m-03-04.thinking.0: Kutsvaga kana chiyero chokurongedza chinofukidza nyaya dzose
z-m-03-04.thinking.2: Kuziva kuti mitemo yakasiyana yakawanda inogoneka
z-m-03-04.prereq.0: Kuziva zvimiro ze triangle, quadrilateral, nedenderedzwa (padanho regiredhi re1)
z-m-03-04.s.s1.prompt: Bhokisi ripi raizonaka kuti makeke eshiri?
z-m-03-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tevera mucheto weshiri nemunwe uye uverenge kuti wakagadzirwa nemitsetse yakananga mingani.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa keke riri mubhokisi re triangle neshiri, uye utaure chinhu chimwe chakafanana nechimwe chakasiyana.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.o.a: Gadzira bhokisi idzva. Haringagoni kupinda mumabhokisi matatu ayo.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakacherekedza kuti nechiyero chazvino hapana nzvimbo yekuriisa.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.o.b: Bhokisi redenderedzwa. Idiki uye rakapfava, saka rinoratidzika sedenderedzwa.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.r.b: Hukuru nekupfava hazvisi chiyero chekuronga zvimiro. Tarisa mitsetse yemucheto.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.o.c: Bhokisi re triangle. Rine makona akapinza, saka rinoratidzika se triangle.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakatarisa chete chokwadi chekuti rine makona akapinza. Shiri ine makona akapinza 5, saka rakasiyana ne triangle.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.o.d: Bhokisi re quadrilateral. Rine makona akapinza akawanda, saka riri padyo ne quadrilateral.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakatarisa chete chokwadi chekuti rine makona akapinza akawanda. Quadrilateral ine mitsetse yakananga 4.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.explain: Shiri i chimiro chakakomberedzwa nemitsetse yakananga 5, saka haisi imwechete ne triangle, quadrilateral, kana denderedzwa. Unofanira kugadzira bhokisi idzva kana kuchinja chiyero.
z-m-03-04.s.s1.acc.0: Kana ukawedzera chiyero uye ukachinja mazita emabhokisi, sa 'zvimiro zvine makona akapinza', unogona kuisa izvi nenzira iyi zvakare. Ipapo ungafanira kuchinja zita rekuti 'bhokisi re triangle'.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvese zvinofanira kuva nemutemo wakanaka wekuronga.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.hint.0: Edza kuisa shiri nemoyo mumutemo wekutanga, uye utarise kana pane bhokisi ravo.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.hint.1: Fungidzira iwe neshamwari imwe neimwe muchiisa makeke amwechete mumabhokisi uye kana achienda kubhokisi rimwechete.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.o.a: Mazita ebhokisi mapfupi, saka akareruka kunyora nekutaura
z-m-03-04.s.s2.r.a: Mazita kuva nyore kunyora zvinoshanda, asi i nyaya yakasiyana nekuti mutemo unoronga zvakanaka here.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.o.b: Keke ripi neripi rinouya, pane bhokisi rimwe zvishoma raro
z-m-03-04.s.s2.r.b: Wakafunga kuti keke rega rega rinofanira kugona kuiswa pasina kusiya.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.o.c: Keke rimwechete rinoenda kubhokisi rimwechete pasinei kuti ndiani anoriisa
z-m-03-04.s.s2.r.c: Wakafunga kuti mutemo unofanira kuva usingaroni zvakasiyana kuvanhu vakasiyana.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.o.d: Painonyanya kuita mabhokisi akawanda, ndipo painonyanya kuva nani
z-m-03-04.s.s2.r.d: Kuita mabhokisi akawanda hakuiti kuti mutemo uve wakanaka. Kana ukaita bhokisi rakaparadzana pakeke rega rega, hapana musoro mukuronga.
z-m-03-04.s.s2.explain: Mutemo wakanaka une nzvimbo yekeke ripi neripi rinouya (pasina chinosiyiwa) uye unoronga zvakafanana pasinei kuti ndiani anozviita. Kuti mazita mapfupi here nehuwandu hwemabhokisi hazvisarudze kana mutemo uri wakanaka kana wakaipa.
z-m-03-04.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza mutemo wekuronga unogona kubata makeke ese, kusanganisira moyo neshiri. Nyora kuti unopatsanura sei mabhokisi uye kuti moyo neshiri zvinoenda kumabhokisi api.
z-m-03-04.s.s3.hint.0: Pachinzvimbo chemazita 'triangle, quadrilateral, denderedzwa' mumabhokisi azvino, edza kuronga nehunhu hwemicheto yemakeke (mitsetse yakananga, mitsetse yakakombama).
z-m-03-04.s.s3.hint.1: Isa makeke 12 rimwe nerimwe mumutemo wako uye utarise kuti hapana keke rinosiyiwa kana kuenda kunzvimbo mbiri.
z-m-03-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Nemutemo wangu, keke rega rega pa makeke 12 rinoenda kubhokisi rimwe chaizvo pasina rinosiyiwa here?
z-m-03-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kwainoenda moyo neshiri, nezvikonzero here?
z-m-03-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Kana mutemo weshamwari imwe wakasiyana newangu, wakafunga kana unogonawo kuva wakarurama here?
z-m-03-04.s.s3.model.0: Moyo neshiri haisi triangle, quadrilateral, kana denderedzwa, saka ndinoita bhokisi rimwe idzva uye ndichizviisa mairi zvakaparadzana.
z-m-03-04.s.s3.model.1: Kana ndikapatsanura kuita mabhokisi maviri, zvimiro zvakagadzirwa nemitsetse yakananga chete (triangle, quadrilateral, shiri) nezvimiro zvine mitsetse yakakombama (denderedzwa, moyo), shiri inoenda mubhokisi rekutanga uye moyo unoenda mubhokisi rechipiri.
z-m-03-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: I mumwe mutemo wakanaka une mazita ebhokisi akachinjwa.

z-m-03-05.title: Teddy bear iri kurudyi kwangu iri kudivi ripi reshamwari yangu?
z-m-03-05.topic: Nzvimbo nenzira (kuruboshwe nekurudyi zvinochinja zvichienderana nenzira yaunotarisa)
z-m-03-05.goal: Tsanangura rini kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwangu nekuruboshwe nekurudyi kweshamwari yangu zvichifanana uye rini zvakapesana, uchipa nzira yekutarisa semamiriro.
z-m-03-05.material: Pane teddy bear padesiki. Ndakagara kudivi rimwe redesiki, uye teddy bear iri kudivi rangu rerudyi. Shamwari iri padyo nedesiki iri, asi haisati yataura kuti iri kupi kana kuti inotarisa nzira ipi.
z-m-03-05.thinking.1: Kufungidzira kuti zvinoratidzika sei kubva pachigaro chakasiyana
z-m-03-05.prereq.0: Kuziva kuruboshwe nekurudyi nekuratidza nzira nemuviri wako (padanho regiredhi re1)
z-m-03-05.s.s1.prompt: Teddy bear iri kudivi ripi reshamwari yangu?
z-m-03-05.s.s1.hint.0: Isa pencil padesiki sa teddy bear, uye sewagara, ratidza pencil nerudyi rwako.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira zvakaparadzana chiitiko apo shamwari yako yakamira pamberi pako nechiitiko apo yakamira kumashure kwako.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.o.a: Iri kuruboshwe kweshamwari yangu. Shamwari yangu inofanira kunge yakagara kudivi rakapesana neni.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakafungidzira kare kuti shamwari yako yakagara kudivi rakapesana yakatarisana newe. Ndiani akataura izvozvo?
z-m-03-05.s.s1.o.b: Hazvigone kusarudzwa. Tinoda kuziva zvakawanda nezve kwayakagara shamwari yangu uye nzira inotarisa shamwari yangu.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakacherekedza kuti mamiriro anodiwa kusarudza haasati apiwa.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.o.c: Iri kurudyi kweshamwari yangu. Kana iri kurudyi kwangu, iri kurudyi kweshamwari yangu zvakare.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.r.c: Wakafungidzira kuti shamwari yako inotarisa nzira imwechete neni. Wakatarisa kuti shamwari yako inotarisa nzira ipi here?
z-m-03-05.s.s1.o.d: Iri pamberi kana kumashure kweshamwari yangu. Yakagara padesiki.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakasanganisa kumberi/kumashure nekuruboshwe/kurudyi. Kutaura kuti bear iri kudivi rangu rerudyi kunoreva kuti iri padivi.
z-m-03-05.s.s1.explain: Kuruboshwe nekurudyi zvinochinja zvichienderana nekuti shamwari yako inotarisa nzira imwechete newe kana inotarisana newe. Kana usingazivi kwayakagara shamwari yako nenzira yainotarisa, haugone kusarudza. (Zvakanakawo kutanga wataura fungidziro yako, sa "ngatitii tinotarisana" kana "ngatitii tinotarisa nzira imwechete," wobva wapindura. Ngatiedzei izvozvo mudanho rinotevera.)
z-m-03-05.s.s2.prompt: Wakaudzwa chimwe chinhu chitsva. "Shamwari yangu yakagara kudivi rakapesana redesiki, ichitarisana neni. Teddy bear ichiri kudivi rangu rerudyi." Teddy bear iri kudivi ripi reshamwari yangu?
z-m-03-05.s.s2.hint.0: Mira wakatarisana neshamwari uye mose mukwidze maoko enyu erudyi. Maoko maviri ari kudivi rimwechete here?
z-m-03-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kana bear iri kurudyi kwangu, wana kuti chii chiri kudivi rerudyi reshamwari yangu.
z-m-03-05.s.s2.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kana muchitarisana, divi rangu rerudyi rinova divi reruboshwe reshamwari yangu.
z-m-03-05.s.s2.r.b: Wakatamisa rudyi rwangu zvakananga kurudyi rweshamwari yangu. Chii chinochinja kana muchitarisana?
z-m-03-05.s.s2.o.c: Pakarepo pamberi kana kumashure kweshamwari yangu
z-m-03-05.s.s2.r.c: Wakasanganisa kumberi nekumashure nedivi. Bear iri padivi rangu rerudyi, ndiko kuti, padivi.
z-m-03-05.s.s2.explain: Kana muchitarisana, kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwemumwe nemumwe zvakapesana. Teddy bear iri kurudyi kwangu iri kuruboshwe kweshamwari yangu.
z-m-03-05.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino shamwari yangu yakamira pakarepo kumashure kwangu, ichitarisa nzira imwechete neni. Teddy bear iri kudivi ripi reshamwari yangu? Taurawo kuti izvi zvakasiyana sei kana muchitarisana.
z-m-03-05.s.s3.hint.0: Zviite nemuviri wako: ruoko rwerudyi rweshamwari yakamira kumashure kwangu itarisa nzira imwechete i kudivi ripi?
z-m-03-05.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa kana maoko erudyi evanhu vaviri ari kudivi rimwechete kana muchitarisana nekana muchitarisa nzira imwechete.
z-m-03-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti mhinduro yangu inobva pamamiriro 'nzira inotarisa shamwari yangu' here?
z-m-03-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaenzanisa chiitiko chekutarisana nechiitiko chekutarisa nzira imwechete here?
z-m-03-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakafungawo nezviitiko apo waifanira kupindura zvakasiyana zvichienderana nekwakamira shamwari yangu here?
z-m-03-05.s.s3.model.0: Iri kurudyi. Shamwari yangu inotarisa nzira imwechete neni, saka rudyi rwangu nerudyi rweshamwari yangu zvakafanana.
z-m-03-05.s.s3.model.1: Ndinofunga iri kurudyi kweshamwari yangu zvakare. Kana muchitarisana inova yakapesana, asi kana muchitarisa nzira imwechete haipesani.
z-m-03-05.s.s3.model.2: Iri kurudyi kweshamwari yangu. Kana tose tichitarisa nzira imwechete, maoko edu erudyi ari kudivi rimwechete, saka hazvishanduki sezvazvinoita kana tichitarisana.

z-m-03-07.title: Kana tikangoisa tsvimbo mbiri panguva padivi pedivi, tinogona kuziva kureba kwedzimwe mbiri here?
z-m-03-07.topic: Kuenzanisa kureba zvisina kunanga (kubatanidza mhedzisiro dzekuenzanisa mbiri panguva)
z-m-03-07.goal: Siyanisa zviitiko apo kubatanidza mhedzisiro dzekuenzanisa mbiri panguva kunoita kuti utaure kureba kwetsvimbo mbiri dzausina kuisa padivi pedivi nezviitiko apo kusingaite, uye ugadzire iwe pachako mikana yakawanda mumamiriro asingagone kusarudzwa.
z-m-03-07.material: Pane tsvimbo tsvuku, bhuruu, nevhuyu. Dzese dzakananga uye hadzitambanuki. Haugone kuisa tsvimbo dzese nhatu padivi pedivi panguva imwe, uye unogona kuisa mbiri chete panguva imwe padivi pedivi. Tinotaura kureba kwetsvimbo se 'huwandu hwematanho'. Mumatanho ari pazasi, uchaudzwa mhedzisiro dzekuisa mbiri padivi pedivi.
z-m-03-07.thinking.1: Kuronga zviitiko apo ruzivo rusina kukwana
z-m-03-07.prereq.0: Kuisa tsvimbo mbiri padivi pedivi uye kutaura kuti ipi iri refu (padanho regiredhi re1)
z-m-03-07.s.s1.prompt: Kana mbiri dzakaiswa padivi pedivi, zvinonzi 'tsvuku i refu kupfuura bhuruu, uye bhuruu i refu kupfuura vhuyu'. Tsvuku nevhuyu hazvisati zvaiswa padivi pedivi. Ipi iri refu?
z-m-03-07.s.s1.hint.0: Isa tsvimbo yebhuruu pakati uye udhirowe mhedzisiro dzekuenzanisa tsvuku nevhuyu imwe neimwe nebhuruu.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ngatitii bhuruu i matanho 5, uye unyore nhamba dzingagona kuva tsvuku nevhuyu imwe neimwe.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.o.a: Vhuyu i refu. Zita rayo rakauya rekupedzisira, saka i refu.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.o.b: Vhuyu i refu. Zita rayo rakauya rekupedzisira, saka i refu.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.r.a: Wakasanganisa kurongeka kwezvakataurwa nekureba. Batanidza mhedzisiro mbiri dzawakaudzwa.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.o.b: Tsvuku i refu. Unogona kubatanidza kuburikidza nebhuruu iri pakati.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.o.c: Tsvimbo mbiri dzakareba zvakafanana. Nekuti bhuruu iri pakati pazvo.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.r.c: Kuva nenhonga pakati hakuiti kuti mbiri dzimwe dzive dzakafanana.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.o.d: Haugoni kuziva usina kuidzira padivi pemumwe iwe pachako.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.r.d: Kuziva zvakananga ndiko kwakachengeteka zvikuru, asi pane nyaya apo unogona kuziva nekubatanidza mhedzisiro mbiri dzawatowana.
z-m-03-07.s.s1.explain: Kana tsvuku yakareba kupfuura bhuruu uye bhuruu yakareba kupfuura yero, saka tsvuku yakareba kupfuura bhuruu uye bhuruu yakareba kupfuura yero, saka tsvuku yakareba kupfuura yero. Inyaya apo nhonga yepakati inoshanda sebhiriji.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino mhedzisiro dzakasiyana. Zvinonzi 'tsvuku yakareba kupfuura bhuruu, uye yero yakarebawo kupfuura bhuruu'. Tsvuku neyero hazvina kuiswa padivi pemumwe. Ndeipi yakareba?
z-m-03-07.s.s2.hint.0: Isa bhuruu se5 matanho uye upe tsvuku neyero nhamba dzipi dzipi dzematanho 6 kana kupfuura.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja nhamba dzaunopa tsvuku neyero uye utarise kana uchiwana nyaya dzose apo imwe neimwe yakareba.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.o.a: Tsvuku yakareba. Zita rayo rakauya pakutanga, saka yakareba.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.r.a: Wakasanganisa kurongeka kwezvakataurwa nekureba. Mumhedzisiro dzawakaudzwa, pakanga paine chakaenzanisa tsvuku neyero zvakananga here?
z-m-03-07.s.s2.r.b: Wakasanganisa kurongeka kwezvakataurwa nekureba. Mumhedzisiro dzawakaudzwa, pakanga paine chakaenzanisa tsvuku neyero zvakananga here?
z-m-03-07.s.s2.o.c: Dzakareba zvakafanana. Nekuti dzose dzakareba kupfuura bhuruu.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.r.c: Dzose kureba kupfuura bhuruu hakureve kuti mbiri dzakafanana. Dzinogona kuva dzakareba zvakasiyana.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.o.d: Hatigoni kusarudza. Chero imwe inogona kureba uye ichiri yakarurama.
z-m-03-07.s.s2.explain: Kana uchiziva chete kuti dzose dzakareba kupfuura bhuruu, tsvuku neyero dzinogona kuva imwe yakareba kana kuva dzakafanana. Unofanira kuidzira padivi pemumwe, kana kuva neruzivo rwakasiyana.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.prompt: Uchichengeta mhedzisiro 'tsvuku yakareba kupfuura bhuruu, uye yero yakarebawo kupfuura bhuruu', gadzira seti 3 dzakasiyana dzekureba kwenhonga umo zvichisiyana kuti ndeipi yetsvuku neyero yakareba (kana kuti dzakafanana). Kureba ndema natural numbers (huwandu hwematanho) kubva ku1 kusvika ku30.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kureba kumwe kwenhonga yebhuruu. Tsvuku neyero dzinofanira kusarudzwa kuti dzive dzakareba kupfuura iyoyo.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.hint.1: Gadzira muenzaniso mumwe umo tsvuku yakareba kupfuura yero, wozochinja nhamba dzenhonga mbiri kugadzira muenzaniso unopesana.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.hint.2: Verenga kuva nekureba kwakafanana senyaya imwe zvakare. Kune muenzaniso wechitatu, isa tsvuku neyero nhamba imwe chete.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.ok.c0: Kureba kwose katatu ndema natural numbers kubva ku1 kusvika ku30.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.fail.c0: Nyora kureba seema natural numbers (huwandu hwematanho) kubva ku1 kusvika ku30.
z-m-03-07.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana (tsvuku, bhuruu, yero) iri (10, 5, 8), tsvuku yakareba; kana iri (8, 5, 10), yero yakareba; uye kana iri (7, 5, 7), dzakafanana. Munyaya nhatu dzose, nhonga mbiri dzose dzakareba kupfuura bhuruu, sezvinotaura mhedzisiro. Saka mhedzisiro iyi oga haigoni kuenzanisa tsvuku neyero.

z-m-03-08.title: Kana chimiro chinoonekwa kubva kumusoro chiri denderedzwa, chinhu chacho chingava chakaita sei?
z-m-03-08.topic: Zvimiro zvakasimba (kuona zvimiro zvebhokisi, ruzhowa rwakaita sekoramu, nebhora zvakasiyana zvichienderana nenzira yaunotarisa)
z-m-03-08.goal: Shanda kana chimiro chinoonekwa kubva kudivi rimwe oga chingatara chinhu, deredza kutonga kwako sezvaunodzidza zvimiro zvinoonekwa kubva kune dzimwe nzira, uye ufanofungidzire chimiro kana chaiswa padivi.
z-m-03-08.material: Pane chinhu patafura, uye sikirini inovanza chikamu zvekuti chikamu chega ndicho chinoonekwa. Chinhu ichi chimwe chezvinotevera: chimiro chebhokisi (chakaitwa nezviso zve square), chimiro chekoramu denderedzwa (denderedzwa uye rakatsetseka kumusoro nepazasi senge tin can), kana chimiro chebhora. Chakaiswa chakamira pasi.
z-m-03-08.thinking.0: Kufunga nyaya dzose dzinogoneka neruzivo rumwe chete
z-m-03-08.thinking.2: Kufanofungidzira chimiro chinochinja kana nzira yekutarisa yachinja
z-m-03-08.prereq.0: Kuziva zvimiro zvebhokisi, zvimiro zvekoramu denderedzwa (tin cans), nezvimiro zvebhora (nhanho yeGrade 1)
z-m-03-08.s.s1.prompt: Nzira dzaunogona kutarisa kubva dzinowedzera imwe imwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza zvaunofunga kuti chinhu chii.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira kutarisa pasi kubva kumusoro kuzvinhu zvitatu uye utaure kuti rimwe nerimwe rinoonekwa sei.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kana uine can chaiyo kana bhora, ritarise kubva kumusoro nekubva padivi uye utsvage zvakafanana nezvakasiyana.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Kutarisa pasi kubva kumusoro, kunoratidzika sechimiro chedenderedzwa.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Bhokisi rinoratidzika sesquare kana rakatarisirwa kubva kumusoro, uye koramu denderedzwa nebhora zvinoratidzika sedenderedzwa kana zvatarisirwa kubva kumusoro. Saka neruzivo urwu oga, zvakaoma kusarudza pakati pekoramu denderedzwa nebhora.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Chimiro chebhokisi. Zvinhu zviri patafura kazhinji mabhokisi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Hauna kutarisa kuti chinhu chinoratidzika chakaita denderedzwa kubva kumusoro chinokodzera sei bhokisi. Bhokisi rinoratidzika sei kubva kumusoro?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hauna kutarisa kana zvinhu zvinoratidzika sedenderedzwa zviri chimwe chete. Zvimwe zvinhu zvinoratidzika sei?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Koramu denderedzwa kana bhora. Hazvioneki sebhokisi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zvitatu zvose zvinogoneka. Chero chinhu chinoratidzika chakaita denderedzwa kubva kumusoro.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Bhokisi rinoratidzika sesquare kubva kumusoro. Hazvisi kuti zvinhu zvitatu zvose zvinogoneka.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Kubva padivi rinoratidzika sechimiro che square, uye kumusoro nepazasi zvakatsetseka.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino unofunga kuti chinhu chingava chii?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Chinhu chinoratidzika sedenderedzwa kubva kumusoro uye square kubva padivi ikoramu denderedzwa. Bhora rinoratidzikawo sedenderedzwa kubva padivi, uye bhokisi rinoratidzika sesquare kubva kumusoro.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ikoramu denderedzwa. Kubva kumusoro inoratidzika sedenderedzwa, uye kubva padivi inoratidzika se square.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaenzanisa zvimiro zvenzira mbiri pamwe chete.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Chimiro chebhora. Chaiva denderedzwa kubva kumusoro, saka chichava chakafanana kubva padivi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Bhora rinoratidzika sedenderedzwa kubva kunzira ipi neipi. Tarisa kana rinokodzera chimiro chinoonekwa kubva padivi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Chimiro chebhokisi. Nekuti chinoratidzika se square kubva padivi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatarisa chimiro chedivi chete. Fungawo chokwadi chekuti kubva kumusoro chaiva denderedzwa.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Idenderedzwa kubva kumusoro uye square kubva padivi, saka hatigoni kusarudza chinhu.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hauna kushanda kana zvimiro zvose zviviri zvinokodzera chinhu chimwe chete. Chinhu cherudzi rupi chine zvimiro zvose zviviri?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Chinhu ichi chakaiswa chakarara padivi uye chakatsigirwa kuti chirege kumhanya.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kana ukatarisa pasi kubva kumusoro kuchinhu chakarara padivi, chichaoneka sei?
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana chakarara, divi racho rinotarisa kumusoro. Chimiro che square chawakaona kubva padivi kana chakamira zvino chinoonekwa kubva kumusoro. Kunyange chinhu chimwe chete chinoratidzika chakasiyana kubva kumusoro zvichienderana nekuti chakaiswa sei.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Chinoratidzika sedenderedzwa. Kubva kumusoro inogara iri denderedzwa.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakatora zvaiva denderedzwa kubva kumusoro kana chakamira pakutanga. Kana chakarara, chiso chinotarisa kumusoro chakasiyana.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Chinoratidzika sema denderedzwa maviri anofukidzana. Nekuti pane zviso zviviri, kumusoro nepazasi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kunyange pane zviso zviviri, kumusoro nepazasi, kana chakarara, chinotarisa kumusoro ndiro divi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Chinoratidzika setriangle. Kana chakarara, makona akapinza anooneka.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kunyange ukarara koramu padivi, hapana makona akapinza anooneka. Fungidzira chimiro chawakaona kubva padivi.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Chinoratidzika serectangle refu. Kana chakarara, divi rinotarisa kumusoro.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakafunga kuti chimiro chinoonekwa kubva padivi pakutanga chinova chimiro chinoonekwa kubva kumusoro kana chakarara.
z-m-03-08.s.s1.reflect: Kufunga kwako kwakachinja sei pakati pekuziva chimiro chinoonekwa kubva kumusoro chete nekuzivawo chimiro chinoonekwa kubva padivi? Kuti udzikise zvinhu zvinogoneka, ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera rwakadiwa?
z-m-03-08.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari yakati, "Zvakaratidzika sedenderedzwa kubva kumusoro, saka ibhora!" Chii chimwe chaungaita kuti uone kana shamwari yako ichiri yakarurama? Nyorawo nei.
z-m-03-08.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti koramu denderedzwa inoratidzika sei kubva kumusoro zvakare.
z-m-03-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga kana pane nzira umo bhora nekoramu denderedzwa zvinoratidzika zvakasiyana.
z-m-03-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Nenzira yandakataura, bhora nekoramu denderedzwa zvinogona kusiyaniswa chaizvo here?
z-m-03-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakati pane chimwe chinhu chinoratidzika chakafanana kubva kumusoro here?
z-m-03-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakafungawo here nyaya apo shamwari yako ingava yakarurama?
z-m-03-08.s.s2.model.0: Unofanira kutarisa kubva padivi zvakare. Koramu denderedzwa inoratidzikawo sedenderedzwa kubva kumusoro, saka pamwe haisi bhora.
z-m-03-08.s.s2.model.1: Unogona kutenderedza chinhu uye utarise kubva kune rimwe divi. Chimiro che can chinewo denderedzwa kubva kumusoro, saka haugoni kutaura nechokwadi kuti ibhora.
z-m-03-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Yakati 'hazvigoni kutaurwa nechokwadi' pamwe chete nechikonzero.
